blocks.x: How Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust rewires Telecom, Media & Entertainment — network intelligence, churn precision and platform economics — engineered at carrier scale, engineered for audit.

In Telecom, Media & Entertainment, cybersecurity & zero-trust covers architecture-level security programs: zero-trust network and workload design, identity modernization, threat intelligence and managed detection, cloud posture management, ai-specific security for models and agents, cyber resilience, and the compliance machinery (soc 2, iso 27001, pci dss, dora) that regulated industries must evidence. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: zero-trust architecture & implementation, threat intelligence & managed soc, identity & access modernization — delivered on Tele Medicine Platform and Driisti Smart Vision Glasses with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: SS7/Diameter weaknesses, API exposure and core-estate sprawl create nation-grade threat surfaces; regulator attention is rising.
Element managers, probes and tickets feed separate systems; NOC decisions remain reactive. The estate generates petabytes that never reach a decision model.
Churn saves run on campaign calendars
Retention offers fire in monthly batches; in-quarter intent signals (support tickets, usage drops, billing disputes) do not trigger saves in the moment.

blocks.x: How we deliver it in this sector

The delivery pattern composes 7 services from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower — Zero-Trust Architecture & Implementation, Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC, Identity & Access Modernization, Cloud Security & Posture Management as the usual core — sequenced through the Achala Method with sector controls: NIS2 / sector cyber regulation obligations shape the design from the first sprint.
Services we deploy in this sector

items: Never trust, always verify — zero-trust as an executable architecture, not a slide.
Detection that keeps pace — intelligence-driven SOC with the boring parts (tuning, coverage) done properly.
Identity as the perimeter — workforce, customer and machine identities on one governed plane.
Secure at the control plane — posture, workload and data security engineered into the platform.
SS7/Diameter hardening and API exposure management (attack paths closed with evidence)
identity-centric access and segmentation across core functions (lateral movement eliminated in validation)
first clean-room products live within two quarters

blocks.x: Two regimes anchor the control design here: NIS2 / sector cyber regulation and NERC/sector-specific grid-adjacent rules (where utility-adjacent). operational compliance for infrastructure roles. Evidence for both is generated by the delivery itself — control tests, replay trails and documentation are artifacts of the program, not a reconstruction project.
